rules.headings: Never use Inter, Roboto, or standard Sans for headings. Use Cormorant Garamond to inject a high-end, luxury beauty feel.
rules.body: Use Manrope for all dashboards, forms, and general SaaS text to ensure maximum legibility.
rules.time_slots: Use Monospace or highly geometric fonts with tracking-wide for times (e.g., 09:00 AM) to align them perfectly in grid layouts.

rules.contrast: Always ensure text has at least 4.5:1 contrast against backgrounds. Never use pure black or pure gray; always tint grays with warmth (sand/bone).
rules.interactive: Hover states must be explicitly defined. E.g. hover:bg-primary/90 hover:text-white. Focus states must have high contrast rings focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/50.
rules.accents: Limit the use of the Accent color (Terracotta) to notifications, unread badges, or secondary distinct CTAs like 'Cancel Booking'.

surfaces.landing_header: Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with a delicate border-b border-border/40. MUST NOT be purely transparent.
surfaces.dashboard_cards: Flat solid background (card), 1px solid border-border, no heavy shadows. Very slight ambient shadow-sm only.
surfaces.radius: Subtle roundness. Use radius-md (8px) for cards, full-rounded (pill-shaped) for time slots and primary CTAs.

visual_enhancers.motion: Use framer-motion for smooth page transitions and micro-interactions. Add stagger to lists of appointments or time slots. ALL buttons must have scale down on active: active:scale-95 transition-transform.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a very subtle SVG noise or grain overlay in the background of the landing page hero to reduce 'digital flatness'.

layouts.landing: Use 'The Bento Grid Mode A' (Tetris Grid) with aggressive asymmetry. Avoid simple 50/50 split sections. Integrate large imagery spanning multiple columns.
layouts.dashboard: Use 'The Bento Grid Mode B' (High Density Grid). 1 to 4 columns. Side navigation (fixed) on desktop, bottom tab bar or hamburger on mobile.
layouts.scheduling_calendar: Display available days horizontally in a scrollable list or compact standard calendar, followed by a dense, wrap-enabled grid of pill-shaped time slots below.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8 or p-12 for major containers. Ensure minimum p-6 inside cards with borders.

components.ui_library: shadcn/ui primitives. Customize heavily to remove default 'Vercel' tech look.
components.booking_flow: Cardless, stepped process. Step 1: Service Select. Step 2: Professional. Step 3: Date/Time (Shadcn Calendar + custom pills). Step 4: Checkout/Sinal (Stripe context).
components.notifications: Use 'sonner' for toasts. Position top-center or bottom-right.
components.forms: React Hook Form + Zod. Inputs must have subtle background colors and clear focus rings.
components.rules: DO NOT use native HTML <select>, <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn components. Override standard tablist height from h-9 to h-auto to prevent clipping.

accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='time-slot-0900').

media.rules: Images must have max-h-[80vh] on mobile devices. Use object-cover for profile avatars and service thumbnails. Hero images require a gradient or solid overlay (bg-black/30) if text overlays them, to maintain contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-end SaaS booking platform for wellness/beauty. Do NOT build a generic tech dashboard.
Use the exact color palette specified to create a warm, organic, and trustworthy environment.
Implement distinct layouts for the Landing Page (asymmetrical bento) vs Dashboard (high-density functional grid).
Prioritize Shadcn components but override their default borders/radii to match the custom organic theme.
In the booking calendar UI, map the time slots cleanly using small pill-shaped buttons with hover/active/disabled states.
Ensure all buttons, form inputs, time slots, and major links have explicit data-testid attributes.
The payment step (sinal/entrada) via Stripe should feel deeply integrated, using clear summary breakdowns before confirming.
Use js files exclusively as the project does not support tsx natively (based on cra-template).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, or uniform styling.
Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic; make the frontend creative and distinctive.
NEVER use emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle glass-morphism effects.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g. transition: all), it breaks transforms.
DO NOT center align the main app container globally.
Add micro-animations to every interaction (hover states, focus rings, entrance staggered animations).
